name: Window tiling
oneLiner: a pile of smoked-glass app windows lands scattered and tipped across a brand-lit desktop, snap zones flash and every window jumps into a clean grid at once, then a pointer double-clicks the brand window's title bar and it maximises over the dimmed rest, showing the brand's own page
say: when the speaker goes from chaos to order or narrows down to one tool ('I had ten apps open', 'it organised everything', 'now I only need this one'): the windows snap on 'organised' or 'sorted', the brand window fills the screen on 'this one'. Set apps, pick and screen
